scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
